service.name: Allied Society Reputation Boost
service.longDescription: From Neutral to Allied, every tribe has a story — and a mount. Our raiders run the daily quests for you, capping any Allied Society in any expansion, or all of them at once.

rewards.title: Target Rank Reached
rewards.text: Any Allied Society raised to your chosen rank — no daily-reset grind.

rewards.title: Exclusive Society Mounts
rewards.text: Each faction offers an exclusive mount at max rank.

rewards.title: Titles & Questlines
rewards.text: Unique titles and NPC stories unlocked across every rank tier.

rewards.title: Currencies & Rewards Kept
rewards.text: Tribe currencies, minions and every reward from each session stays yours.
